text:
nina: Heads-up: vendor-orbit-logistics says H100 EU ETA moved from 7d -> 13d due to a customs backlog at Port C. This will squeeze our Dedicated EU pool for next sprint.

vendor-orbit-logistics: confirmed. Options: (1) push full ocean (13d) no surcharge; (2) split 15 air (3d) + 25 sea (12-14d) w/ air expedite $2.5k/unit; (3) provide loaner credit: we can loan 12 units from a partner pool in region for 10d @ $500/unit handling fee. We can preprint RMA labels and include depot photo checklist if PO amendment signed. Observed burn-in fail ~0.4%.

maya: @vendor-orbit-logistics please upload ETA table, serial manifest (csv), and sample depot photo checklist. We need the exact RMA label format for our scanning pipeline.

vendor-orbit-logistics: will attach manifest + checklist in 90m. RMA format: ORBIT_{depot}_{po}_{serial}. Depot requires photos within 24h or they may hold warranty acceptance.

sam: quick math for 15 air: 15*2500 = 37,500. Loaner 12 units handling = 6,000 + customs unknown. Air gets us to target by D+4.

``` 
air_cost = 15*2500 = 37500
loaner_cost = 12*500 = 6000
```

sam: Air expensive but fastest. Is D+4 critical?

liam: For EU tenant onboarding we need +25 GPUs by D+6. Current EU slack = 10. If we take 15 air + 25 sea -> slack +15 = 25 (short by 0). If we add loaners 12, we exceed requirement but loaners return D+10.

ops-eu: we can reassign 4 spare GPUs from staging but that still leaves a gap. Cross-DC transfers take ~8-10d.

nina: priority = onboarding. @procurement-bot open PO amendment for split ship + loaner credit option. Flag finance for expedite approval. Add clause: 2 spares per 100 and in-box preprinted RMA labels, plus depot photos <=24h.

procurement-bot: PO 56234_amendment created -> awaiting approval. Tagging @finance.

vendor-orbit-logistics: recommend adding 1% spare buffer due to burn-in. We'll include crate-level photos and manifest with photo_md5. Spares included at no extra freight if amendment signed.

maya: agree to spares and require CSV columns: serial, sku, shipped_ts, depot_id, photo_md5, burnin_flag. Also SLA: depot photos within 24h, RMA pickup within 72h for failures.

finance: approve up to $40k expedite under one-off code 4310. Please route final invoice.

sam: OK approving 15 air + loaner 12. Procurement to finalize amendment and confirm invoice allocation.

procurement-bot: amendment updated with finance approval. Vendor to confirm pick/pack and provide airwaybill + manifest.

vendor-orbit-logistics: confirmed. Air AWB: ORB-EU-555 (ETA 72h). Ocean BL: ORB-BL-333 (ETA 13d). Loaner units staged and will ship on receipt of signed MOU. Manifest and depot checklist uploaded.

ops-eu: prepping depot teams for 24h photo SLA and RMA pickup staging. Adding depot contacts to manifest comments.

liam: create a short dashboard card to track burn-in per crate and RMA scan success. Alert if burn-in >0.5% or if photo turnaround >24h.

nina: vendor, send final amended invoice + crate photos. Procurement, close loop once invoice routed. We'll review spare policy effectiveness in the post-wave review.

vendor-orbit-logistics: will send invoice + photos in 1.5h. Tagging @nina @maya.

procurement-bot: PO 56234_amendment -> vendor confirmed -> invoice routed to finance. Thread archived for 45d for post-mortem and RMA metrics.
